_what: NUMBERS read by a person on the remake capture 'r_20261029_054537_throne_room_orange' (third-party material: only these numbers are in the repo, never pixels). Valid area = the whole capture, 1278 x 643 px (no player bar, no minimap; a channel icon in the bottom right corner, x > 0.985 and y > 0.90, left out). Units: H = the height of the leader in px at its own feet (about 67.5 px; its feet are hidden by the hero behind it, +-4 px); fractions of the valid area. Eye + ruler on 4x crops: about +-5 px. The luma boxes are computed (BT.601 mean over the box / 255), not read by eye. A reading, not a measurement of the game.

hero.note: the leader = the top one of the column of five (dark spiky hair), walking to the throne

camera.pitch_deg: about 33-35 (asin of the ratio, square tiles assumed; +-5)

P.note: the two grey stone masses: they leave the frame at the bottom and at the sides
